paragraphs.source_en: A light blossoms from Ragnar. He steps forward like some wayward pilgrim, white light glowing along the knuckles of his armor. I see no weapons. Mustang tenses, confused.

units.source_en: A light blossoms from Ragnar.
He steps forward like some wayward pilgrim, white light glowing along the knuckles of his armor.
I see no weapons.
Mustang tenses, confused.

paragraphs.source_en: “I am and always have been son to the people of the Valkyrie Spires. Born free to Alia Snowsparrow on the wild pole of Mars, north of the Dragon’s Spine, south of the Fallen City.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Forty-four scars have I earned for Gold since the slavers of the Weeping Sun came from the stars to take my family to the Chain Islands. Seven scars from others of my kind when they placed me in the nagoge, where I was trained.”

units.source_en: “Forty-four scars have I earned for Gold since the slavers of the Weeping Sun came from the stars to take my family to the Chain Islands.
Seven scars from others of my kind when they placed me in the nagoge, where I was trained.”
He kneels at my side.

paragraphs.source_en: “One from my mother. Five from the talons of the monster who guards Witch Pass. Six from the woman who taught me to love. One from my first master. Fifteen from men and beasts I fought in an arena for the pleasure of the Allmother and her guests. Nine I earned for the Reaper.”

units.source_en: “One from my mother.
Five from the talons of the monster who guards Witch Pass.
Six from the woman who taught me to love.
One from my first master.
Fifteen from men and beasts I fought in an arena for the pleasure of the Allmother and her guests.
Nine I earned for the Reaper.”

paragraphs.source_en: The ground sighs under the weight of his knees.

units.source_en: The ground sighs under the weight of his knees.

paragraphs.source_en: “For Gold, I have buried three sisters. One brother. Two fathers.” He pauses in sadness. “But … for them I have never earned a scar.”

paragraphs.source_en: Through his armor’s pale light, his black eyes burn like witchflames.

paragraphs.source_en: Ragnar closes his eyes, putting himself at the mercy of a Gold. Having faith like I have faith. Like Eo, like Sevro, and Dancer and all the rest.

paragraphs.source_en: My eyes meet Mustang’s, perhaps for the last time, and I imagine I feel the same as did my ancestors, the first pioneers to Mars, as they looked back across the darkness to Earth. In her I had a home. I had love. And then I poisoned her to me. I know this was always destined to be our end. But still I hope like a desperate child.
